metadata.description: Vault Genome: one Azure Confidential VM (AMD SEV-SNP) that stands itself up from the signed release, proves the deployment and keeps running. Generated by deploy/azure/make-template.sh from deploy/azure/guest.sh; do not edit by hand.
The VM's name; every resource carries it.
A region with the DCasv5 series (West Europe, East US).
An AMD SEV-SNP Confidential VM size.
The ssh user (sudo). The daemons run as root services; the record is readable by this user.
The ssh public key of the person deploying (one line, ssh-ed25519 or ssh-rsa).
The signed release to deploy (a tag). The guest verifies its checksums list under the release workflow's identity for this tag before it runs anything.
Who may reach port 22: your address as a.b.c.d/32, or * for anyone with the key. The Vault Genome listeners bind loopback only.
Set by deploy.sh: the SHA-256 of the checksums list it verified; the guest refuses a different list.

bootLogCommand.value: [concat('az vm boot-diagnostics get-boot-log -g ', resourceGroup().name, ' -n ', parameters('vmName'), ' -o tsv')]
